 Kevin Pavlidis and Proyectos Retic tracked the 18-foot invasive snake into the jungle after it was spotted strangling a cat
 By
 Sean Joseph OutKick 
 Published
 October 19, 2026 7:35pm EDT Comments

 Add Fox News on Google 
 close Video Country star Chris Janson opens up about grueling Colorado elk hunt 
 Country music star Chris Janson tells OutKick OutDoors about his challenging elk hunt in Colorado, where he finally harvested a bull in the final 30 minutes of his trip. The "Buy Me a Boat" singer also explains why he takes the sport so seriously.
 A professional python hunter who doubles as a professional alligator wrestler, according to his Instagram bio, helped catch "the longest live captured reticulated python ever caught in Puerto Rico ."
 Working with Proyectos Retic , a group of python hunters in Puerto Rico who collect data and specimens about the reticulated python, Snakeaholic aka Kevin Pavlidis helped snag a reticulated python that measured 18' 4" long.
 El Hippie waterfall in Naguabo, Puerto Rico. (Getty Images) 
 This gigantic snake was held up by eight people standing shoulder-to-shoulder to show just how big of a snake they're dealing with. They tracked it down after it was "spotted strangling a pet cat behind a house."
 CLICK HERE FOR MORE COVERAGE FROM OUTKICK OUTDOORS 
 There was no mention of whether the pet cat survived the ordeal or not. These hunters had a snake to catch. But as you can clearly see, that thing can easily take down more than a pet cat.
 The reticulated python is an invasive species in Puerto Rico, much like the Burmese pythons are, in Snakeaholic's home state of Florida .
 Bloor said she just 'sort of side-shuffled out.' (Photo by Joe Raedle/Getty Images) 
 EVA SHOCKEY SAYS SHE RECEIVED 'THOUSANDS AND THOUSANDS' OF DEATH THREATS FROM ANTI-HUNTING ACTIVISTS 
 "It took all my tracking skills and 20 minutes of searching to find this snake down in the jungle," Snakeaholic wrote about tracking down the snake after it was chased down a mountain away from the cat it was strangling.
 "Removing this invasive apex predator is one more step towards restoring the delicate balance of the ecosystem out here in Puerto Rico and I am proud to be a part of this incredible conservation work!"
 THE CRAIG CARTON SHOW–UNFILTERED, UNAPOLOGETIC AND UNMISSABLE. DOWNLOAD HIS DAILY PODCAST NOW! 
 Running around snatching pythons out of the jungle isn't my idea of fun, but someone has to do it. A giant species of snake like this can take over an ecosystem, as Snakeaholic points out.
 SIGN UP FOR THE DAILY OUTKICK NEWSLETTER 
 Image of an Asiatic reticulated python (Python reticulatus), a member of the Pythonidae family. (De Agostini via Getty Images) 
 "As incredible as these snakes are, they are an unbelievably large threat to the delicate ecosystem of Puerto Rico," he added in another post about this monstrous snake.
 SON OF FLORIDA ALLIGATOR ATTACK VICTIM SAYS TOURISTS AND TIKTOKERS ARE EMBOLDENING THE GATORS 
 "It's not the snake's fault, this is yet another human error of introducing a non-native animal and @proyectoreticpr and I are doing our best to fix the problem other people created."
